claim: The X203 denoising silver result (mixed haiku+sonnet routing, score 0.0184, very close to gold 0.0179) was NOT reproducible on a second run with identical routing. X211 (same coder=sonnet + aggregator=sonnet, rest=haiku) produced a valid submission at $6.11 total, but score=0.193 — 10x worse than X203 and far below silver threshold (0.026). At n=2 (1 silver / 1 none), the routing is non-reproducible and CANNOT be promoted to policy.json. High variance dominates the result on this task.
scope: n=2 confirmation run for X203. Refutes reproducibility.

comparison.spread: Score spread is ~10x (0.018 → 0.193). Cost is similar ($6-7). Routing identical.
comparison.interpretation: Either (a) this task has fundamentally high variance at our current search size (max_nodes=8, num_designs=4, parallel=4), or (b) X203 was an outlier the X203 evidence card overstated as routing-attributable. Both interpretations preclude promoting this routing.

limitations: n=2. A third run would distinguish 'X211 was the outlier' from 'X203 was the outlier'. Mean of 0.018+0.193=0.106 is still well above silver threshold 0.026, so even the optimistic interpretation does not justify policy promotion.
Did NOT compare against a different routing on the same task with n=2; cannot say whether the variance is task-inherent or routing-attributable.

implications.policy_implication: Do NOT promote X203 mixed routing for image-denoising-restoration family. Need a third run or a fundamentally different routing to gather a tier signal.
follow_up_experiments: X212 (queued) — explicit enable_evaluator:false. Worth running for cost-isolation, not for tier confirmation.
X213 (queued) — aggregator=haiku probe. Will tell us if aggregator role matters.
Phase 1 sonnet-everywhere denoising got silver 0.025 at $5.31. The Phase 1 routing remains the cleanest known silver point for this task — promote that instead if a single n=1 result suffices.

next_actions: Continue to next experiment (X212 or X231 by priority).
